name: P2P Co-Draw modal creates encrypted host WebRTC signaling token and enforces guest structural mutation locking
description: Validates opening the P2P Co-Draw collaboration modal from the studio header, generating an end-to-end encrypted room offer token, inspecting connection status indicators and security policies, and validating that structural mutations are host-authoritative.

planSteps.description: Click the Co-Draw collaboration button in the top navigation bar
Verify the P2P Co-Draw modal dialog opens with Host Session and Join Session tabs
Click the Generate Invite Code button in the Host tab
Verify an encrypted WebRTC room offer token string is generated inside the shareable text area
Verify the peer status indicator reflects waiting state and the LAN-first privacy notice confirms zero cloud data logging
Click the 'Join Session' tab in the modal header
Verify the join panel displays the invite code paste input and disabled Connect button awaiting input
Click the modal close button to dismiss the dialog
Verify the dialog dismisses and the studio canvas workspace remains interactive
